# langfuse_organization_llm_connection (Resource)

Manages an organization-level LLM connection, which is available to every project of the organization. Requires an organization-scoped API key. Langfuse upserts connections by provider_name; applying a name that already exists updates that connection. secret_key and extra_headers are write-only at the API and are retained in Terraform state; use a secure state backend. Changes made to them outside Terraform are not detected. Import format: organization_public_key:organization_private_key:connection_id. After import, supply secret_key and any extra_headers in configuration because the API cannot recover them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "organization_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "organization_private_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "llm_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Available to every project of the organization.
resource "langfuse_organization_llm_connection" "example" {
  organization_public_key  = var.organization_public_key
  organization_private_key = var.organization_private_key
  provider_name            = "openai-shared"
  adapter                  = "openai"
  secret_key               = var.llm_secret_key
  custom_models            = ["gpt-4o-mini"]
}

resource "langfuse_organization_llm_connection" "bedrock" {
  organization_public_key  = var.organization_public_key
  organization_private_key = var.organization_private_key
  provider_name            = "bedrock-shared"
  adapter                  = "bedrock"
  secret_key               = var.llm_secret_key
  config                   = jsonencode({ region = "eu-central-1" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `adapter` (String) The LLM service type. Valid values: anthropic, openai, azure, bedrock, google-vertex-ai, google-ai-studio.
- `organization_private_key` (String, Sensitive) The organization private key used to authenticate API calls.
- `organization_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The organization public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `provider_name` (String) The unique name of the connection within the organization. It is the upsert key, so changing it replaces the resource.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The API authentication key for the LLM provider.

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Base URL override for the LLM provider API. Langfuse rejects hosts it cannot resolve.
- `config` (String) Adapter-specific configuration as a JSON object. Required for bedrock (must contain `region`), optional for google-vertex-ai (must contain `location`), and not supported by other adapters.
- `custom_models` (List of String) Custom model identifiers offered by this connection.
- `extra_headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Additional HTTP headers sent with LLM API requests.
- `with_default_models` (Boolean) Whether to offer the adapter's default models. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the LLM connection.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The API cannot return the LLM secret or extra header values after import.
# Supply those values in configuration before applying.
terraform import langfuse_organization_llm_connection.example "${ORGANIZATION_PUBLIC_KEY}:${ORGANIZATION_PRIVATE_KEY}:${CONNECTION_ID}"
```
